# Pavel Levdin — Innovativ Digitalbau

> Pavel Levdin (Innovativ Digitalbau) is a web developer based in Hannover, Germany. He builds websites and web platforms for small and medium businesses: landing pages, business websites on Next.js with a headless CMS, online shops, web apps and client portals, CRM/Telegram integrations, AI automation, SEO and AI search optimisation. The site is available in Russian (primary), German and English.

Projects are fixed-price per brief; the final price is agreed after the brief. Typical starting prices: landing page from 45 000 ₽, small website (5–7 pages) from 80 000 ₽, business website on Next.js + CMS from 120 000 ₽. German and English pages show the same prices in EUR, converted at the Central Bank of Russia rate.
